mapper.sql: review_id, fair_id, user_id, rating, content, is_verified_visit AS verifiedVisit, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fair_reviews (fair_id, user_id, rating, content, is_verified_visit, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{fairId}, #{userId}, #{rating}, #{content}, #{verifiedVisit}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT fr.review_id, fr.fair_id, fr.user_id, u.nickname, fr.rating, fr.content, fr.is_verified_visit AS verifiedVisit, fr.created_at, fr.updated_at FROM fair_reviews fr JOIN users u ON u.user_id = fr.user_id WHERE fr.fair_id = #{fairId} ORDER BY fr.created_at DESC, fr.review_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT fr.review_id, fr.fair_id, f.name AS fairName, f.poster_image_url AS fairPosterImageUrl, fr.rating, fr.content, fr.is_verified_visit AS verifiedVisit, fr.created_at, fr.updated_at FROM fair_reviews fr JOIN fairs f ON f.fair_id = fr.fair_id WHERE fr.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY fr.created_at DESC, fr.review_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
